import type * as $t from "./types";

// [react]'s api_base, which each route's path goes after.
export const $base = "";

/** Runs proc P: `POST /api/p` on http server web-api. */
export async function p(args: { readonly acc: readonly number[]; readonly i: number }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<readonly number[]> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/p", {
    "acc": $encList($encInt)(args.acc),
    "i": $encInt(args.i),
  }, opts);
  return $decList($decInt)(v, "result");
}

export function $enc_St(x: $t.St): unknown {
  return {
    "acc": $encList($encInt)(x.acc),
    "i": $encInt(x.i),
  };
}

export function $dec_St(v: unknown, at: string): $t.St {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    acc: $decList($decInt)($field(o, "acc", at), at + ".acc"),
    i: $decInt($field(o, "i", at), at + ".i"),
  };
}

==== hooks.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A React hook per route of each HTTP server, over client.ts: each gives the
// route's last result or error and whether a call is in flight, and cancels
// calls that are no longer wanted.

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";

/**
 * Runs proc P through p (`POST /api/p` on http server web-api): with args,
 * whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useP(args?: { readonly acc: readonly number[]; readonly i: number } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly acc: readonly number[]; readonly i: number }, readonly number[]> {
  return $useCall($c.p, args, opts);
}
